Name: Birthday and Gift Notification
Author: supremedumbling
Description:
Hi! Thank you for visiting my mod. This is my first mod, and I had lots of fun learning about modding! I hope you will find this mod useful as well :) 

The Birthday and Gift Notification mod displays a notification at the start of the day when an NPC is celebrating their birthday. Along with the reminder, the mod shows a list of that NPC's loved and liked gifts so you can quickly choose the perfect present.

How it works:
The mod hooks into the game's day start event and checks if any NPC has a birthday that day. If so, it retrieves the NPC's gift preferences from Stardew Valley's internal NPC gift data and displays the item names.

Installation:
1. Install SMAPI
2. Download and unzip this mod
3. Place the mod folder into your Stardew Valley / Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI

This mod does NOT modify save files and does NOT alter gameplay mechanics.

Downloads.Description: To install, download the BirthdayGiftNotif.zip and copy/paste the folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
